Neutral.text: The notebook is on the table.
I will send the summary after lunch.

Calm.text: We can take this one step at a time.
There is enough time to finish it.

Happy.text: That turned out better than I hoped.
I am glad you are here today.

Amused.text: Well, that was an unexpected plot twist.
I did not see that coming at all.

Excited.text: We leave at dawn and I cannot wait.
The results just came in and they are good.

Tender.text: I kept the light on for you.
You do not have to explain it all.

Sad.text: I miss the way the evenings used to be.
The chair by the window is empty.

Disappointed.text: I expected the train to be on time.
This is not the outcome I prepared for.

Angry.text: That deadline was agreed and then ignored.
Please stop moving the goal after we start.

Fearful.text: I heard a sound in the hall and I froze.
Something about this route does not feel safe.

Surprised.text: I did not expect the door to open.

Disgusted.text: The bin has been sitting there all week.
That smell does not belong in the kitchen.
